announcements.headline: Extension of Subscription Payment
announcements.insight: Coastal Africa Group extends a subscription payment following earlier loan notes. This follows admission to AIM and director appointments.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Non-Executive Director
announcements.insight: Coastal Africa Group appointed a Non-Executive Director following its AIM admission. This board change may influence governance as the company continues its early operations.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Non-Executive Director
announcements.insight: Coastal Africa Group appoints a non-executive director. This board change follows its recent admission to AIM and loan note extension.

announcements.headline: Loan Notes and Extension of Subscription Payment
announcements.insight: Coastal Africa Group issues loan notes and extends subscription payments following its June admission to AIM. This indicates ongoing capital raising activities post-listing.

announcements.headline: Admission to AIM and First Day of Dealings
announcements.insight: Coastal Africa Group is admitted to AIM, marking its first day of dealings. This listing enables future capital raising and enhances shareholder liquidity.
